resolution.note: backlog triage 2026-11-07: Improves retired delivery ceremony (briefs/review/verify/slice/deliver/worker/red-first/hardening checklist)

title: Ship verifier requires the applied hardening checklist
body:
Outcome: krn ship (scripts/pr-preflight.mjs ship verifier) refuses to merge a PR whose base or head carries docs/program/hardening-checklist.md unless the PR head has the krn deliver review-binding status for a record with a matching, applied checklist digest, so the by-hand ship path in krn-lead step 8 cannot skip the checklist that krn deliver enforces (src/deliver/checklist.ts).
Evidence: PR #162 pre-panel sweep (.krn/archive/worktree-runs/feat-hardening-checklist-*/claude/hardening-checklist/lead/sweep.md); a second review prepass showed a prepass-blocked record cannot be --prior-record (no panel roles), so two attempts were consumed by single prepass judges; fold that into t-1xjh05h.
